recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the applied FHIR-17048 example defect without broadening scope to the unresolved FHIR-40498 request or adding optional editorial changes.
issue_request: FHIR-17048 was Published/Persuasive for STU3 and requested that the ifNoneExist and conditional update examples declare the identifiers used by their conditional search criteria.
initial_application: Commit 2aabd5950d83268fab71bf57f77c3527ea95b0d5 (svn r14444) applied the issue by adding Patient.identifier elements and changing the conditional create/update criteria, but introduced the system as http:/example.org/fhir/ids.
additional_context: Bundle is active in source/fhir.ini; bundle-transaction is listed as an example and the HTTP narrative links it with bundle-response. FHIR-31965 later added a matched conditional-create response body and copied the same identifier system into bundle-response.xml. FHIR-40498 is a later Triaged/unresolved enhancement request about conditional references and was not decided.
reconciliation: Changed source/bundle/bundle-transaction.xml and source/bundle/bundle-response.xml to use http://example.org/fhir/ids in the resource identifiers and matching conditional search criteria. No patient demographic edits were made because the semantic issue request is satisfied by the identifier linkage.
source_changes: source/bundle/bundle-transaction.xml: changed the conditional create/update identifier system and search criteria from http:/example.org/fhir/ids to http://example.org/fhir/ids.
source/bundle/bundle-response.xml: changed the matched conditional-create response Patient.identifier.system to http://example.org/fhir/ids.

related_jiras.note: Later reconciliation added the matched conditional-create response body and copied the same identifier system into bundle-response.xml, so the response example needed the same URL correction.
Later Triaged/unresolved request asks to add conditional references to the transaction example; it is not a final decision and was not decided here.
